author: TheTower03
quote: The game looks phenomenal and improves on some mechanics from GTA V but the story is not as well written and the characters aren't as interesting. The missions are also 75% running errands and lack much engagement. It's a well made and enjoyable game but it is not near perfect. I've seen reviews talking about realism but GTA is not a realistic house chore simulator. Genuinely disappointing and greedy choices made by rockstar. Underwhelming release for what could have been a phenomenal game.
